raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Agent details Prepared with AI assistance. Add an opt-in dense causal BF16 SDPA override using strided Q/K/V views and native cuDNN/Flash selection. Keep existing document-aware training unchanged by default. Packed text also needs an explicit data policy: `TextCollator.Config(mask_document_boundaries=False)` makes positions continuous within each context row before MTP token counting. It applies equally to training and validation; labels and padding remain unchanged. Source-document packing limits are ignored with a warning in this mode, while attention metadata capacity is derived from context rows rather than source documents. Enable both overrides: ```bash --override torchtitan_recipes.overrides.dense_causal_sdpa.dense_causal_bf16_sdpa,torchtitan_recipes.overrides.dense_causal_sdpa.unmasked_text_rows ``` For DeepSeek fused MLA, use the combined factory. It composes the existing fused MLA and dense attention implementations without weakening parent/child override conflict checks: ```bash --override torchtitan_recipes.overrides.dense_causal_sdpa.dense_causal_fused_mla,torchtitan_recipes.overrides.dense_causal_sdpa.unmasked_text_rows ``` Dense attention requires one full, unpadded context row. Unsupported Flex attention, document resets, padding, windows, context parallelism, and incomplete token layouts fail explicitly. Multiple flattened context rows keep their boundaries and require varlen attention. Fixed two-offset dense metadata does not require a document-capacity setting. Disabling document boundaries changes training semantics, not only performance. Already-continuous frozen sources can use the attention override alone. Pipeline validation CUDA graphs are owned by #5241; this PR does not duplicate that feature. ## Test Plan ```bash python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/data/test_grain_data.py tests/unit_tests/cpu/components/test_validator.py tests/unit_tests/cpu/models/common/test_varlen_attention.py tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_trainer.py -q -k 'not graph_training' python -m pytest tests/unit_tests/gpu/recipes/test_dense_causal_sdpa.py -q ``` --- Stack created with GitHub Stacks CLI • Give Feedback 💬

+### Continuous causal rows without document masking
+
+`TextCollator.Config(mask_document_boundaries=False)` replaces source-document
+position resets with a continuous range within each `max_context_length` row.
+The default `True` preserves existing document-aware positions. Labels remain
+next-token aligned by the source/processor; padding and loss masks are preserved.
+Positions are finalized before MTP counting, so RoPE, attention boundaries and
+MTP shifts agree on which tokens belong to the same causal sequence.
+
+With masking disabled, `GrainDataLoader` disables the source-document packing
+cap: `max_num_documents` is inapplicable and a configured value emits a warning.
+The token budget still bounds packing. Attention metadata capacity is derived
+from the number of context rows, independently of source-document packing, so
+its shape remains fixed for CUDA graphs. Setting the packing cap to one would instead pad
+short documents; it does not concatenate them into an unmasked sequence.
+
+For one full, unpadded context row per microbatch, enable the dense attention and
+text-data overrides together (the data override covers training and validation):
+
+```bash
+--override torchtitan_recipes.overrides.dense_causal_sdpa.dense_causal_bf16_sdpa,torchtitan_recipes.overrides.dense_causal_sdpa.unmasked_text_rows
+```
+
+The dense kernel still rejects padding, position resets, CP and incomplete
+sequence-parallel layouts. Multiple flattened context rows retain resets between
+rows and need the normal varlen attention path. Frozen sources already supplying
+one continuous full row can use the attention override alone and skip repacking.
+Disabling document masking changes training semantics, not just performance.
+
+For DeepSeek with fused MLA, use the combined factory instead of separate
+parent/child overrides:
+
+```bash
+--override torchtitan_recipes.overrides.dense_causal_sdpa.dense_causal_fused_mla,torchtitan_recipes.overrides.dense_causal_sdpa.unmasked_text_rows
+```
+
+The combined factory reuses the existing fused MLA implementation and dense
+inner attention. The override framework still rejects independent parent/child
+claims; their order would otherwise decide which replacement survives.
+Both dense factories require a plain causal varlen-attention recipe; unsupported
+Flex/CP/window configurations fail instead of silently leaving another backend.
+Dense metadata has a fixed two-offset shape and does not need a document cap,
+including for already-continuous frozen rows with CUDA graphs enabled.
+
 With effective DP greater than one, `repeat=False` is rejected because ranks can exhaust at different steps and hang training collectives. Use `repeat=True` and let the trainer's step count stop training.

+"""Opt-in dense causal BF16 SDPA for one continuous, unpadded token row.
+
+For packed text, activate both component overrides with ``--override``::
+
+    torchtitan_recipes.overrides.dense_causal_sdpa.dense_causal_bf16_sdpa,torchtitan_recipes.overrides.dense_causal_sdpa.unmasked_text_rows
+
+The data override applies to training and validation text collators before
+MTP counting, RoPE and attention metadata. It preserves labels/padding and
+removes source-document resets, not logical context-row boundaries. Dense
+SDPA requires one full context row per microbatch and still rejects padding.
+Already-continuous frozen sources may use the attention override alone.
+Context parallelism and sliding-window attention are unsupported.
+Sequence parallelism is supported when the attention projections gather the
+complete token row before this kernel boundary.
+
+For DeepSeek MLA fusion, use ``dense_causal_fused_mla`` instead of separate
+fused-MLA and dense-inner overrides. One factory owns the parent/child change,
+avoiding an order-dependent replacement; both existing implementations are reused.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import ClassVar
+
+import spmd_types as spmd
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch.nn.attention import sdpa_kernel, SDPBackend
+from torchtitan.components.data.collators import TextCollator
+
+from torchtitan.config import derive, override
+from torchtitan.models.common.attention import (
+    InnerAttention,
+    VarlenAttentionMetadata,
+    VarlenInnerAttention,
+)
+from torchtitan.models.deepseek_v3.model import Attention
+
+__all__ = [
+    "DenseCausalBf16SDPA",
+    "dense_causal_bf16_sdpa",
+    "dense_causal_fused_mla",
+    "unmasked_text_rows",
+]
+
+# T = tokens, H = heads, K = query/key head dimension, V = value head dimension.
+
+
+@spmd.no_typecheck(out_types=spmd.PartitionSpec(("dp", "cp"), "tp", None))
+def _dense_causal_sdpa(q_THK, k_THK, v_THV, *, scale, enable_gqa):
+    """Run SDPA on strided batch/head views at the opaque kernel boundary."""
+    with sdpa_kernel(
+        [SDPBackend.CUDNN_ATTENTION, SDPBackend.FLASH_ATTENTION], set_priority=True
+    ):
+        out_BHTV = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
+            q_THK.transpose(0, 1).unsqueeze(0),
+            k_THK.transpose(0, 1).unsqueeze(0),
+            v_THV.transpose(0, 1).unsqueeze(0),
+            is_causal=True,
+            scale=scale,
+            enable_gqa=enable_gqa,
+        )
+    return out_BHTV.squeeze(0).transpose(0, 1)
+
+
+class DenseCausalBf16SDPA(VarlenInnerAttention):
+    """Causal BF16 attention with cuDNN then Flash backend preference."""
+
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class Config(VarlenInnerAttention.Config):
+        _requires_document_capacity: ClassVar[bool] = False
+
+        def build_attention_metadata(
+            self,
+            positions: torch.Tensor,
+            *,
+            padding_mask: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+            max_num_documents: int | None = None,
+            max_context_length: int | None = None,
+        ) -> VarlenAttentionMetadata:
+            """Validate one continuous row once during input preprocessing."""
+            del max_num_documents, max_context_length
+            if positions.ndim != 1 or positions.numel() == 0:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "Dense causal SDPA requires a nonempty 1D position row."
+                )
+            torch._assert_async(
+                (positions[1:] == positions[:-1] + 1).all(),
+                "Dense causal SDPA requires continuous positions; enable unmasked_text_rows "
+                "for packed text and use one context row per microbatch.",
+            )
+            if padding_mask is not None:
+                if padding_mask.shape != positions.shape:
+                    raise ValueError("padding_mask must match the position row.")
+                torch._assert_async(
+                    ~padding_mask.any(), "Dense causal SDPA does not support padding."
+                )
+            offsets = torch.tensor(
+                [0, positions.numel()], dtype=torch.int32, device=positions.device
+            )
+            if spmd.is_type_checking():
+                spmd.mutate_type(offsets, "dp", src=spmd.R, dst=spmd.V)
+            return VarlenAttentionMetadata(
+                offsets, offsets, positions.numel(), positions.numel()
+            )
+
+    def __init__(self, config: Config) -> None:
+        if config.window_size != (-1, 0):
+            raise ValueError("Dense causal SDPA requires window_size=(-1, 0).")
+        super().__init__(config)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        q_THK: torch.Tensor,
+        k_THK: torch.Tensor,
+        v_THV: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        attention_metadata: VarlenAttentionMetadata,
+        scale: float | None = None,
+        out_transform=None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Apply causal SDPA to BF16 projections covering the complete row."""
+        if out_transform is not None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Dense causal SDPA does not expose an LSE output transform."
+            )
+        if not isinstance(attention_metadata, VarlenAttentionMetadata):
+            raise ValueError("Dense causal SDPA requires preprocessed row metadata.")
+        if any(
+            tensor.ndim != 3 or tensor.dtype != torch.bfloat16
+            for tensor in (q_THK, k_THK, v_THV)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Dense causal SDPA requires BF16 [tokens, heads, features] projections."
+            )
+        if (
+            attention_metadata.cu_seq_q.numel() != 2
+            or attention_metadata.cu_seq_k.numel() != 2
+            or attention_metadata.max_k != attention_metadata.max_q
+            or any(
+                tensor.shape[0] != attention_metadata.max_q
+                for tensor in (q_THK, k_THK, v_THV)
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Dense causal SDPA projections must cover one complete token row; CP or incomplete SP layouts are unsupported."
+            )
+        return _dense_causal_sdpa(
+            q_THK, k_THK, v_THV, scale=scale, enable_gqa=kwargs.get("enable_gqa", False)
+        )
+
+
+@override(
+    target=InnerAttention.Config,
+    description="Use dense causal BF16 SDPA for continuous unpadded token rows.",
+)
+def dense_causal_bf16_sdpa(
+    cfg: InnerAttention.Config,
+) -> DenseCausalBf16SDPA.Config:
+    """Replace plain causal Varlen attention while preserving its module config."""
+    if type(cfg) is not VarlenInnerAttention.Config or cfg.window_size != (-1, 0):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Dense causal SDPA requires plain causal Varlen attention; CP and sliding windows are unsupported."
+        )
+    return derive(cfg, DenseCausalBf16SDPA.Config)
+
+
+@override(
+    target=TextCollator.Config,
+    exact=True,
+    description="Use continuous context-row positions for training and validation text.",
+)
+def unmasked_text_rows(cfg: TextCollator.Config) -> TextCollator.Config:
+    """Disable source-document masking before collation computes MTP counts."""
+    return derive(cfg, TextCollator.Config, mask_document_boundaries=False)
+
+
+@override(
+    target=Attention.Config,
+    exact=True,
+    description="Compose existing fused DeepSeek MLA with dense causal BF16 attention.",
+)
+def dense_causal_fused_mla(cfg: Attention.Config) -> Attention.Config:
+    """Replace MLA assembly and its inner attention as one coherent override."""
+    from torchtitan_recipes.overrides.fused_mla import fused_mla
+
+    inner_attention = cfg.inner_attention
+    if not isinstance(inner_attention, VarlenInnerAttention.Config):
+        raise ValueError("Dense causal MLA requires plain causal Varlen attention.")
+    fused_config = fused_mla(cfg)
+    fused_config.inner_attention = dense_causal_bf16_sdpa(inner_attention)
+    return fused_config
